narrative_purpose: Shows compartmentation solving itself: fatty-acid bags assembling, holding contents, and splitting under flow inside a mineral pore, with no genome directing any of it.
subject: The interior of a rough irregular mineral pore, its walls porous and pitted, filled with dark fluid. Within it float nine translucent spherical bubbles of varying sizes, each with a thin bright rim marking its membrane. Three of the larger bubbles contain a faint coiled strand of small linked beads visible through their translucent walls. One bubble near the centre has been drawn out into a dumbbell shape and is pinching closed at its waist, mid-division. A slow flow through the pore is suggested by soft streaklines in the fluid that bend around the bubbles.
scene: A greatly magnified view inside a single pore of a vent chimney wall, the mineral surface curving around the top and bottom of the frame to enclose the space.
camera: A close view fully inside the pore, the mineral walls framing the top and bottom edges, the bubbles at mid-depth.
light: Faint cool light with no clear source, giving each bubble membrane a delicate cyan rim and leaving their interiors dim; the mineral walls catch a weak teal sheen on their raised edges and fall into shadow in the pits.
palette: Void-indigo fluid, pale cyan bubble rims, living-teal for the coiled strands inside the bubbles, the mineral walls in desaturated near-black stone with cool highlights.
style: Painterly microscopy plate in naturalist manner, hand-painted texture, translucency handled with soft washes rather than glassy rendering.
detail_level: Crisp on the bubble rims, the dividing waist and the coiled contents; the mineral walls textured but subdued; the flow streaklines very soft.
composition: The dividing bubble placed slightly left of centre as the focal element, the others distributed around it at varying depths, a plain dark region of fluid at the upper right for an overlaid callout.
consistency_notes: The bubbles must read as simple single-walled membrane spheres, not as modern cells with internal organelles or a nucleus. The strands inside are single coiled beads, not double helices. Mineral surface matches the porous chimney material of the other plates.
